title: Aurora UI
subtitle: Accessible component library
description: A themeable component library for design-system teams, built on native CSS custom properties. Every component ships with a documented accessibility contract, not just a Storybook page.

title: Pathfinder
subtitle: Visual git history explorer
description: A desktop tool that renders a repository's branch and merge history as an interactive graph, so reviewing a tangled history takes minutes instead of a full afternoon of `git log`.

title: Quiet Hours
subtitle: Focus-time scheduling for teams
description: A lightweight scheduling layer that sits on top of existing calendars and protects blocks of uninterrupted work time across a whole team, with a public status page for each person.

title: Ledger Lite
subtitle: Local-first budgeting tool
description: A budgeting app that keeps every record on-device by default, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync. Built to prove a local-first architecture can still feel instant.

title: Typeset
subtitle: Fluid type-scale generator
description: A small utility that generates a full, accessible fluid type scale from three inputs, and exports it as ready-to-use CSS custom properties.

title: Signal Boards
subtitle: Incident status pages
description: Self-hosted status pages for small engineering teams, with a CLI that posts incident updates directly from a terminal during an outage.
